review.sourceObservation: Personallyread allfiveclosedunits: Stage6Standard1833–1862; originalNormal2 inverse118–179, rawQ3207–223, Q5–7245–269, unknownmeanQ7626–653. Source explicitlyteaches x=mean+zSD and alternativelysubstitute/rearrange; unknownmean directlyassessedQ7.
